svg.title: Жим гири одной рукой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing SINGLE-ARM KETTLEBELL strict shoulder press. ONE recognizable round kettlebell with LOOP HANDLE, no dumbbells. Left figure: right elbow bent and close to torso, fist at chin/shoulder, kettlebell rests against OUTSIDE/BACK of forearm in rack. Right figure: right arm straight overhead, wrist neutral, kettlebell hangs behind wrist/forearm. Left arm stays relaxed by side. Both figures stand on floor, no chair or bench. Front 3/4 view. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
